messages:
Lena K.: Hi all — quick heads up: my calendar shows tomorrow's orientation at 2pm local but the invite email says 11am. I'm in CET, anyone else seeing this?

Marco V.: Same confusion. I'm in WET and it looked like 10am for me on the invite but calendar shows 11. Probably a TZ mix.

DevEx Sam: Sorry for the noise. We had a draft invite created in PT and a final one in UTC; some clients merged them. Canonical time is 11:00 UTC (check the updated invite I just sent).

DevEx Sam: Quick fixes: delete any duplicate events, then re-open the updated invite and click "Add to calendar". If you downloaded an old .ics, clear it first. Links for both live sessions and recordings are in the invite description now.

IT ops: For engineered calendars on Exchange, if duplicates persist DM me — I can remove the stray event server-side. Also set a 30m reminder for cross-TZ attendees.

Lena K.: Thanks — re-added and now shows correctly as 12:00 CET. Appreciate the fast follow-up.

calendar-bot: Recording will be posted ~30 minutes after the live session to: https://drive.redwood.com/onboarding/recordings/latest.mp4

Marco V.: Perfect. I'll also join the EMEA repeat if anything runs over. :thumbsup:
